name: Google Classroom
hint: A web OAuth client in your Google Cloud project with the Google Classroom API enabled, and a teacher’s or a Workspace for Education admin’s refresh token for these scopes under https://www.googleapis.com/auth/: classroom.courses.readonly, classroom.rosters.readonly, classroom.coursework.students, classroom.announcements, classroom.topics.readonly, classroom.courseworkmaterials.readonly, classroom.guardianlinks.students.readonly, classroom.profile.emails, for example from the OAuth 2.0 Playground; an External app left in Testing gets tokens that end after 7 days.

pick.name: list_courses
pick.says: Lists the courses this account may see, newest first: a teacher or student sees their own, a domain administrator every course in the domain. teacherId or studentId (a user id, an email or me, never both) narrows it; courseStates takes one of ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, PROVISIONED, DECLINED, SUSPENDED.

pick.name: get_course
pick.says: Returns one course: name, section, courseState, ownerId and alternateLink; id is the course’s id or an alias.

pick.name: list_students
pick.says: Lists a course’s students, each with a userId and a profile holding their name; a profile’s email comes back only if the refresh token was granted the classroom.profile.emails scope.

pick.name: list_teachers
pick.says: Lists a course’s teachers, each with a userId and a profile holding their name; a profile’s email comes back only if the refresh token was granted the classroom.profile.emails scope.

pick.name: list_coursework
pick.says: Lists a course’s coursework, last updated first; only PUBLISHED items unless courseWorkStates is DRAFT or DELETED. orderBy takes updateTime or dueDate, each with asc or desc, e.g. dueDate asc.

pick.name: get_coursework
pick.says: Returns one piece of coursework: title, description, workType, state, dueDate and dueTime in UTC, and maxPoints. associatedWithDeveloper is true when it belongs to this OAuth client’s Cloud project, the only project Google lets edit it or grade and return its submissions.

pick.name: list_submissions
pick.says: Lists the submissions to one piece of coursework, or to all of a course’s coursework when courseWorkId is -, each with its state, late flag and grades. userId (a user id, an email or me) narrows it to one student; states takes one of NEW, CREATED, TURNED_IN, RETURNED, RECLAIMED_BY_STUDENT; late takes LATE_ONLY or NOT_LATE_ONLY.

pick.name: get_submission
pick.says: Returns one student submission: state, late, draftGrade and assignedGrade; draftGrade is seen only by the course’s teachers.

pick.name: list_announcements
pick.says: Lists a course’s announcements, last updated first; only PUBLISHED ones unless announcementStates is DRAFT or DELETED.

pick.name: list_topics
pick.says: Lists a course’s topics, each a topicId and a name; coursework and materials name their topic by topicId.

pick.name: list_coursework_materials
pick.says: Lists a course’s material posts, each with a title, a description and attached links, Drive files, videos or forms, last updated first; only PUBLISHED ones unless courseWorkMaterialStates is DRAFT or DELETED.

pick.name: list_guardians
pick.says: Lists a student’s guardians; studentId is a user id, an email or me. Guardians must be enabled for the domain, whoever asks; then a teacher reads the guardians of students in their own classes and a domain administrator any student’s, and studentId - (every student’s) is for administrators only.

pick.name: create_coursework
pick.says: Creates coursework, a draft unless state is PUBLISHED; title and workType are required, dueDate and dueTime are in UTC, and only this OAuth client’s Cloud project may later edit it or grade and return its submissions. Body: {"title", "workType": "ASSIGNMENT", "description", "state": "PUBLISHED", "maxPoints", "dueDate": {"year", "month", "day"}, "dueTime": {"hours", "minutes"}, "topicId", "materials": [{"link": {"url"}}]}.

pick.name: create_announcement
pick.says: Posts an announcement in a course, a draft unless state is PUBLISHED. Body: {"text", "state": "PUBLISHED", "materials": [{"link": {"url"}}]}.

pick.name: grade_submission
pick.says: Grades a submission as a teacher of the course, only on coursework this OAuth client’s Cloud project created (associatedWithDeveloper true). updateMask is draftGrade (seen only by teachers) or assignedGrade,draftGrade (the grade returned to the student), never assignedGrade alone. Body: {"draftGrade": 90, "assignedGrade": 90}.

pick.name: return_submission
pick.says: Returns a turned-in submission to its student, as a teacher of the course and only on coursework this OAuth client’s Cloud project created (associatedWithDeveloper true). It does not copy draftGrade into assignedGrade, so set assignedGrade first. Body: {}.
